answer: A resident credential lives on the authenticator itself, so sign-in needs no username and no server-side handle. A farm must provision 515 resident credentials on 515 devices, since each authenticator stores only its own set. The pulse test is the price tag: 515 fakes mean 515 payments. The credential ID is looked up fresh each epoch, and the authenticator must present the same resident key. The violet signal is visible to every grader, and the crystal ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
